scope: Offline fixed Nov06 camera mount counterfactual on old-mount raw captures; no deployment, angle optimization, policy or sensor changes.
training: existing stationary pretrial frame 0 only; fixed visually reviewed ROI [360,480,1100,710], stride4, seed0, RANSAC120, tolerance.01m, SVD refinement; same historical protocol
stationary_heldout: two existing pretrial captures, fixed same ROI; same position, not independent pose or physical truth
moving_heldout: legacy actual episode frames 0,18,22 and previously RGB-selected ground/cabinet ROI in validation/protocol.json; selected independently of map connectivity
comparison: legacy actual base-camera TF versus fixed Nov06 base-camera TF from confirmed calibrated backup and TF receipt. Both projected from same raw depth/K and frame historical odom-base, no new TF calibration; fit once per fixed mount using same training pixels.
frame_convention: floor height evaluated at training base XY and expressed relative to base; historical odom epochs differ, constant base-relative reference is assumed and disclosed
limitations: Visual ROI identity, scalar flat-floor approximation, cross-epoch transfer, no independent ground-truth measurement, no safety or physical success claim.
